title.zh: HSBC Names Hong Kong Stablecoin 'RedCoin' Ahead of Retail Rollout
title.en: HSBC Names Hong Kong Stablecoin 'RedCoin' Ahead of Retail Rollout

current_state.zh: HSBC has named its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin 'RedCoin', with a retail rollout planned for the second half of 2026 and initial distribution limited to the PayMe wallet and the HSBC HK Mobile App.
current_state.en: HSBC has named its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin 'RedCoin', with a retail rollout planned for the second half of 2026 and initial distribution limited to the PayMe wallet and the HSBC HK Mobile App.
